caption: 0g added sugar, tastes like Snickers! Recipe ⬇️ My kids beg for candy after dinner, so I make this instead! Medjool dates pitted and cut in half, laid flat on a cutting board Topped with a generous spread of creamy peanut butter (1/4-1/3 cup) Sprinkled with roasted salted peanuts (1/4 cup) Topped again with melted 80% dark chocolate (about half a small bar) Sprinkled with sea salt Refrigerate for 4-8 hours Enjoy!
